servers.name: enhance-pir-coordinator-01
servers.role: shared filter/coordinator; process CPU/RSS unavailable from metrics

cache_conditions: Client stores and retrieval setup caches start cold. Shared prior-ledger preparation may warm PIR server caches. No server cache eviction is performed. Mixed runs PIR first; fresh runs blocks first.
background_work: PIR fleet continues normal publication and may serve other traffic. Server counters include background work. Baseline host is dedicated to this benchmark.
transport: Public TLS from the same Amsterdam load generator for both backends; colocated regional latency, not Canadian WAN latency. Encoded HTTP payloads exclude headers and TLS framing.
block_layout: Length-delimited per-block protobuf messages; gzip is applied independently to each immutable batch of up to 1000 blocks.
metrics_scope: All six retrieval workers plus filter-service metrics. The filter service does not export process CPU/RSS, so those fields are unavailable; no total-system CPU claim is made. Block counters cover batch payloads submitted by the dedicated server.

prior_ledger_preparation.scope: Complete PIR recoveries with the supplied window digests checked; only events before each measured range are imported. Identical seed files are supplied to both methods.

metrics_transport: Private Amsterdam SSH tunnels: loadgen to baseline for block metrics; coordinator to loadgen reverse tunnel for filter metrics. Six workers directly over VPC. Independent of operator Mac connection.
pir_filter_mode: Standard per-shard filters; optional parent-filter experiment disabled.
client_source_note: Source archive ae75d12 with the SQLite coverage append fix from 1d95ebf. Both methods use this same frozen executable.
baseline_cache: Server startup checksum verification reads all artifacts. No filesystem cache eviction is performed; the dataset exceeds server RAM.
baseline_scope: Controlled HTTP serving of exported per-block compact protobufs, batched and gzip-compressed. This is not a latency measurement of a deployed lightwalletd GetBlockRange service.
fleet_conditions: Normal shared-fleet publication continues. Five workers and one recent canary currently have different binary hashes; hashes and raw APM are retained, so this is not a controlled uniform-version fleet test.
prior_diagnostic_run: full-20260909 interrupted for quadratic SQLite fix; full-20260909-linear-coverage passed all 80 recoveries but had operator-network APM gaps. This repeat uses fresh client stores and private APM; preceding runs may warm servers.
